trigger: UEC Sentinel defeated in the City
note: Quiet beat before the Ruins. Reuses stills; VO via ElevenLabs.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Sentinel falls. Neon rain ticks on quiet plating. For a moment the City holds its breath.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Voss's channel stays open — listening, not firing. The path south will open when you are ready. Not yet.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Hold fire. I want her alive until the Core. If this ghost is real, I want to hear it lie — on record.

lines.speaker: GAIA
lines.text: Kaela. Priority handoff: the Archivist has a packet for this window. Query him before you enter low-signal terrain.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The road to the Core is not only drones and ash. It is a choice you still have time to understand.

panels.then: title card THE CITY HOLDS ITS BREATH over the upper sky
